summary: National Healthcare Properties filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 25, 2026, certain purchaser termination rights expired under a July 15, 2026 purchase and sale agreement with an unaffiliated third party to sell its 40-property outpatient medical facility portfolio for approximately $531 million before expenses, prorations and capex adjustments. No price per share, premium or advisor is stated. Closing is expected in Q4 2026 subject to customary conditions; the PSA will be filed with the Q3 2026 Form 10-Q. Watch for financing, diligence and cap-ex adjustment risk before Q4 close.
